name: ARCHIVE: Worlds Within Worlds (film studio)
summary: The 90-minute, ten-chapter feature: a playable studio with chapter jumps, 360 and VR modes.
description: Raymarched GLSL worlds rendered by the film's own engine. Open the studio to play, scrub, preview 360 / VR 3D and record; render the full film with render/render.mjs.
